answer: Sybil resistance is a scarcity of unique live presence, not a cheap puzzle. Each applicant must keep a nectar bond of 250 POA locked for four epochs on a named ledge that cannot be reassigned, and must answer a 75-second probe from three randomly sampled established peers. The median RTT has to stay under 90 ms; a timeout or a second booking of the same slot slashes 80 POA and freezes the key. Weight accrues only after five successful probes against a vine of distinct counterparties. Device clocks that cluster within 3 ms, or reused TLS session tickets, collapse the cluster to one identity.
